mapper.sql: SELECT t.id, t.task_name, t.target_dept_id, t.tester_id, t.start_date, t.end_date, t.status, t.create_by, t.create_time, d.dept_name, u.nick_name FROM apms_test_task t LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON t.target_dept_id = d.dept_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON t.tester_id = u.user_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO apms_test_task (task_name, target_dept_id, tester_id, start_date, end_date, status, create_by, create_time) VALUES (#{taskName}, #{targetDeptId}, #{testerId}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, #{status}, #{createBy}, NOW())
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM apms_test_task WHERE id IN #{id}
